survivors.name: Paige
survivors.line: Paige rescued. 'Next time, I want to be the one holding the door.'

survivors.name: Ellis
survivors.line: Ellis rescued: 'Take my pistol and six bullets. I can work, but I can't fight or guard.' Right click to shoot; left click still swings.

survivors.name: June
survivors.intro:
I kept the medicine safe.
Let's get this place working.

survivors.name: Oliver
survivors.intro:
The plants made it through. So did I.
Give me a safe route and we can feed everyone.

survivors.name: Theo
survivors.line: Theo joins the team: 'I know every road in this district. Point me and I will keep watch.'
survivors.intro:
Delivery driver. I sheltered here when it started.
I can hold a post or stay at your shoulder.

survivors.name: Nia
survivors.line: Nia joins the team: 'Give me a safe route and I will get the power back on.'
survivors.intro:
Electrical technician. I like to explain a repair once,
then do it.

survivors.name: Rowan
survivors.line: Rowan joins the team: 'I know where everything useful is kept. Let me help.'
survivors.intro:
Community-centre caretaker. I have keys to half this place.
Put me where I am useful.
